# Research log — 24 October 2026

Public sweep before the bold theme gate. Inspiration only. Nothing here is a source to port. Login-walled boards (Pinterest, some Behance and Dribbble shots, Spline and Rive community apps) were reached through open write-ups, award pages, and gallery indexes, not by copying a file.

## What is actually trending

2026 award work has split in two. Product sites (Linear, Vercel, Stripe, Raycast, Framer) still ship quiet chrome, one accent, and fast micro-feedback. Award sites (Awwwards SOTD, FWA, CSS Design Awards) are pushing back against that sameness: one strong material, kinetic type, and a motion system with a single ease language. Svilenković’s mid-2026 SOTD reading and the Envato trends piece (Adi Purdila, 30 March 2026) agree on the losers: generic particle fields, purple-on-black templates, glass with unreadable type, and motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Patterns that keep showing up, and the personality they belong to:

| Signal | Where it showed up | Personality we take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Liquid glass as depth, not frosting | Apple’s Liquid Glass write-ups, Fluid Glass (Exo Ape, Awwwards), RLVNT Studios (Orpetron, Feb 2026) | Lagoon only. Blobs and radius morph. No page-wide blur. |
| Kinetic type, split characters, split-flap | Envato 2026, Codrops scroll text, Mat Voyce (Awwwards SOTD, FWA), Motion.dev text guide | Strike only. |
| One WebGL scene that is the story | Oryzo (Lusion, SOTD 13 Apr 2026, palette `#100904` / `#FF8539`), Minh Pham portfolio, IKEA “Convive mejor” shader, Spline used as a small product stage | Orrery only. One scene, capped pixel ratio. |
| Squash, bounce, playful state | IKEA FWA questionnaire, Adrian Vlasov on FWA (Aug 2026), Lottie for one-shots and Rive for state machines | Rally only. DOM squash and a short confetti burst, not a Lottie file. |
| Technical scan, grid, terminal type | Codrops terminal typography, Mobbin’s shipped dashboard patterns, dashboard clients | Array only. |

Micro-interactions are table stakes in 2026 (Framer trends, Creative Alive, Line25): hover, press, focus, open, close, success, error, and loading each need a different beat, under about 200ms for controls. Scroll scenes and hero motion are separate and must not run on every input.

Registries on 21st.dev (Aceternity, Magic UI, Motion Primitives, Cult UI) are the look to beat and not to copy. Aurora backgrounds, glow beams, and shimmer buttons are now the template. A theme that could be mistaken for one of those fails the devil’s veto.

## What we refuse

- Beige notebooks, newsprint, and limestone. The owner rejected that set as regular.
- One animation reskinned five times.
- Blur on a scrolling layer, animated `box-shadow`, and animated `background-position`.
- A cursor spotlight that listens on the whole page for every theme.
- Shipping a component the five critics have not all scored at 8 or above.

## Sources

Awwwards SOTD and WebGL indexes, Oryzo AI (13 Apr 2026), Fluid Glass, GQ × Audemars Piguet Extraordinary Lab, Svilenković “Awwwards 2026 3D”, Minh Pham and Mat Voyce case studies (June 2026), FWA (Adrian Vlasov, IKEA Convive mejor), CSS/FWA-adjacent write-ups, Envato Elements trends (30 Mar 2026), Codrops On-Scroll Text Motion, Motion.dev text animation, 21st.dev library index and the 20 Aug 2026 Magic UI alternatives note, snapcn’s 21 Oct 2026 registry comparison, Framer “UI trends 2026”, UPDOT, Line25, Creative Alive on motion UX, Design Lounge split-flap brief, Orpetron on RLVNT, Godly/Land-book/Lapa/Siteinspire/One Page Love/Minimal Gallery by the same award circulation (kinetic type, one material, scrollytelling). Pinterest and Dribbble boards were not scraped; the motifs that leak from them into these write-ups are liquid glass, kinetic posters, and candy 3D buttons, which map to Lagoon, Strike, and Rally and nowhere else.
